svg.title: East Australian Current100m source fields and uncertainty support
svg.desc: Eight dated source-field panels preserve the2013–2015missing period; source support and fixed WGS84 array geography are shown. Source bottom zeros, SOM filling, mapping and uncertainty limitations remain explicit. No physical current dimensions are supplied.
